title: Confidence Ledger
description: Schema for tracking the certainty of product requirements and scope elements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ledger entry.

statement.description: The product requirement, scope element, or domain rule.

confidenceState.description: The current resolution state of the entry.

source.description: Origin of the statement (e.g., user request, inference, research).

rationale.description: Explanation of why the entry is in its current state.
